set.body:
Current joint human-study parent for preview, DL1/DL3/DL4/DL6 and selected graph/readout scientific claims. Plan: docs/plans/2026-11-16-detail-mapping-plan.md#human-reference. Reuse protocol bd-01M50KBFT26DRB77VFHPRHYNA2, material bd-01M50KC744836VNJ8F8A4AHNWH and execution bd-01M50KD0NHVPCEHGZND9H18M6E. Existing people/data/protocol approvals remain binding; preserve the separate within-scene human lane. This is not the synthetic G3 recovery court.
Prepare the joint rubric and timing pilot on seen/throwaway data. Freeze every evaluated implementation before the single untouched read, including DL6 and any graph/readout method. Fresh samples must have verified exposure eligibility; old development-only sampling is superseded for confirmatory claims, while seen FilmFestival remains transfer evidence. If preview is evaluated earlier or a method changes after the read, new confirmation requires disjoint fresh data.
Study acceptance: one independently recomputed report gives per-criterion outcomes, denominators, abstentions/failures, uncertainty and exposure limits. Preserve reverse/revisit, repeated/multiple-occurrence and ambiguous cases; do not instruct chronology enforcement. Include localization/specificity and any claimed transition/group-effect recovery. Coder agreement is a task-specific reference, never automatically a ceiling. No participant prose committed.
The proposed DL1 relative agreement 0.8, DL3 per-class precision 0.8, DL4 kappa 0.6 and DL6 interval-excludes-zero comparison remain qualification criteria to finalize before the protocol. Study completion may be negative/inconclusive; a failed criterion withholds its claim. Engineering readiness is not scientific qualification.
set.title: G3: joint human detail/event coding and organization-recovery qualification
